newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ALKORTA HEADER GIVES REAL 2-1 CUP WIN OVER VALLADOLID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALKORTA HEADER GIVES REAL 2-1 CUP WIN OVER VALLADOLID.

text.p: League leaders Real Madrid will take a 2-1 advantage to Valladolid for the second leg of their third round Spanish Cup tie thanks to a rare headed goal by international defender Rafael Alkorta in Thursday's first leg.
The victory was a poor reward for Fabio Capello's side, who dominated the second half after seeing Valladolid's Raul Ibanez equalise a 15th minute effort by Croatian striker Davor Suker.
Capello had hoped to rest Predrag Mijatovic for the game, but was forced to bring on the Yugoslavian international in an attempt to capitalise on Real's territorial dominance.

The game may prove to be the last with Real for Portuguese international Carlos Secretario, whose place on the right side of defence is threatened by the arrival of Christian Panucci, the former AC Milan player.
